verdict.rationale: Trivy is a CLI scanner that users report is easy to automate: it slots into CI/CD pipelines, runs unattended in CI, and comes bundled with the Harbor registry for automatic image analysis. Any background or autonomous execution depends on external schedulers, CI systems or host platforms rather than a native automation feature. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduling or continuous background-scan capability, documented automation or trigger setup, and any agent-driven autonomous workflow evidence.
